findings: Since Jun 2026 (21 Mon–Sun weeks): Meta spend vs organic halo revenue correlates weakly (lag-0 r≈0.48, lag-1 r≈0.3) — moves together sometimes, not lockstep.
Meta-attributed Shopify sales track halo better than spend alone (lag-0 r≈0.38). Good Meta weeks avg ~$4383.0 organic halo vs ~$4207.0 on bad weeks.
Rule-of-thumb from weekly data: ~$1.295 organic halo Shopify $ per $1 Meta spend (non-causal; includes Oct partial week).
